title: Luno
bio: Luno is a cryptocurrency exchange and wallet app that lets users buy, sell and store bitcoin and other digital assets.

title: Magoosh
bio: American online test preparation company that offers video lessons and practice questions for the GRE, GMAT, LSAT, SAT and other exams.

title: Malt
bio: Malt is a European freelance marketplace that connects companies with independent consultants in technology, design, marketing and other fields.

title: MasterClass
bio: American subscription streaming platform offering video classes taught by well-known experts in cooking, writing, business, music and other subjects.

title: Medium
bio: Online publishing platform where writers post articles and stories, and readers can follow authors through a paid membership.

title: Memrise
bio: British language learning app that teaches vocabulary and conversation skills using videos of native speakers and interactive practice.

title: Mercado Bitcoin
bio: Mercado Bitcoin is a Brazilian platform for buying, selling and trading cryptocurrencies and other digital assets with Brazilian reais.

title: Mercury
bio: Mercury offers online business banking, including checking accounts, cards and payment tools, aimed at startups and small companies.

title: Mollie
bio: Mollie provides online payment processing for businesses in Europe, supporting cards, bank transfers and local payment methods.

title: MoMo
bio: MoMo is a Vietnamese mobile wallet app for money transfers, bill payments, mobile top-ups, shopping and financial services.

title: Monzo
bio: British app-based bank offering current accounts, savings pots, budgeting tools, loans and business accounts managed from a smartphone.

title: MUBI
bio: Curated film streaming service, distributor and production company focused on independent, classic and international cinema.

title: Myntra
bio: Indian online fashion and beauty store, owned by Flipkart.

title: N26
bio: N26 is a Berlin-based mobile bank offering current accounts, debit cards, savings and budgeting features to customers in Europe.

title: Namshi
bio: Namshi is an online fashion retailer in the Middle East selling clothing, shoes, beauty products and accessories from many brands.

title: Netlify
bio: Cloud platform for building, deploying and hosting websites and web applications with continuous deployment and serverless functions.

title: Ninja Van
bio: Singapore-based parcel delivery company providing last-mile delivery services for online sellers across Southeast Asia.

title: NoBroker
bio: NoBroker is an Indian property platform that connects owners with tenants and buyers directly and offers home services.

title: Noise
bio: Noise sells smartwatches, wireless earbuds and smart rings in India.

title: Noom
bio: American health app that offers weight management programmes based on behaviour change, food logging and coaching, plus access to prescription options.

title: Nothing
bio: Nothing makes smartphones, wireless earbuds and headphones with transparent design elements, plus the CMF sub-brand of budget devices.

title: Notion
bio: Notion makes a connected workspace app for notes, documents, wikis, databases and project management.

title: Nuvei
bio: Nuvei provides payment processing technology that lets businesses accept card, digital wallet and local payments online and in person.

title: Odoo
bio: Odoo develops open source business management software with apps for accounting, sales, inventory, websites and other operations.

title: Ola
bio: Indian ride-hailing app for booking cabs, autos and bikes.

title: Omio
bio: Berlin-based travel booking platform that compares and sells train, bus, flight and ferry tickets.

title: Oura
bio: Oura makes a smart ring that tracks sleep, heart rate, activity and other health metrics through a companion app.

title: Outschool
bio: American online marketplace offering live small-group video classes and tutoring for children and teenagers taught by independent teachers.

title: OYO
bio: Indian hospitality company listing budget hotels and homes for booking online.
